note: Draft 2's timed read (26 Nov). c01-c04 are the characters (barber, student, rickshaw driver, chaiwala), cast by the 'cast' run; af_heart's takes of them are not used. n01-n08 are the narrator.
ref_text: The lane was busy, and nobody looked twice.

lines.text: You there, keep a hand on your wallet. There's a pickpocket at the east gate.
Did you hear? There's a pickpocket at the east gate, everyone's saying it!
East gate, saab. Pickpocket. Police are going there now.
He's at the west gate, where he took a wallet in the very first second.
He whispered it to the barber himself, so the three people who warned you were one man, three times.
None of them had seen him, but a thing you hear three times starts to feel true.
And every warning sent a hand to a pocket, yours too, and showed him where the money was.
So while the police ran east and grabbed the first man they saw running,
he walked back through every pocket he'd seen them touch.
You there, keep a hand on your wallet.
